nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Listens for inbound user messages. Uses the Telegram credential.

nodes.name: Authorize (allowlist)
nodes.notes: Drops messages whose chat id is not in TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS (security.md §3). Unauthorized items stop here, protecting LLM/db quota.

options.systemMessage: You are a media-intelligence analyst for a single YouTube creator's corpus. Answer the user's question by consulting the 'search_corpus' tool to retrieve relevant historical transcript excerpts, then synthesise across time: highlight how the creator's stance, topics or arguments have evolved or contradicted themselves. Cite the video ids you used. If the corpus has nothing relevant, say so.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: Agentic RAG: combines the deep chat model, Postgres chat memory and the Supabase corpus tool.

nodes.name: OpenRouter Chat Model (deep)
nodes.notes: Use an OpenAI credential whose Base URL is overridden to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

nodes.name: Postgres Chat Memory
nodes.notes: Persists conversation per Telegram chat id into the chat_history table (supabase/schema.sql).

parameters.toolDescription: Semantic search over the creator's historical transcript corpus. Input a natural-language query; returns the most relevant transcript excerpts with their video ids.

nodes.name: Supabase Corpus (Retrieve as Tool)
nodes.notes: Retrieve-as-Tool mode lets the agent decide when to query the knowledge base (architecture.md §5). Needs an Embeddings sub-node (ai_embedding).

nodes.name: Embeddings (OpenRouter)
nodes.notes: Must match the model/dimension used at insert time (vector(1536) in schema.sql). Use an OpenAI credential with Base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

nodes.name: Telegram - Reply
nodes.notes: Sends the agent's answer back to the originating chat.
